adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, when a destination calendar has a `credentialId` that is not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, the code fetches it from the DB (`prisma.credential.findUnique(...)`) and uses it for `createEvent`, but does not add/cache that fetched credential back into `this.calendarCredentials`. The same pattern appears in the update path (`updateAllCalendarEvents`) where it again conditionally fetches missing credentials from the DB. This is a concrete, diff-grounded inefficiency/caching concern (potential repeated DB lookups) rather than a correctness bug.
